Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject in the platform.

id.description: Subject unique ID (e.g., math, chemistry, physics).

icon.description: Material Icon or Lucide icon name.

color.description: Subject visual design color hex or color name.

bgColor.description: Subject badge background visual state color.

exercisesCount.description: Total exercises/quizzes count in the bank.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Represents a lecture chapter within a subject with educational summaries and formula cards.

subjectName.description: Read-only copy of of the parent subject's name.

progress.description: Overall student completion of the lesson (0-100).

lastStudied.description: ISO timestamp indicating when last read.

summary.description: Comprehensive HTML/Markdown text explanation of study contents.

formulaTitle.description: Short heading of formulas showcase block.

formulas.description: List of core mathematical or chemical equations.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A specific practice task or objective for a student to accomplish with associated rewards.

completed.description: Indicator of whether the action is fully registered.

QuizQuestion.title: QuizQuestion
QuizQuestion.description: A single multiple choice quiz question inside the question bank.

options.description: Options list including correct and decoy entries.

explanation.description: A detailed solution brief explaining why this answer stands out.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: A registered member profile with points trackers, active status, streaks, and system authorizations.

streak.description: Consecutive days returning to keep daily streak.

status.description: Account visual status: active or suspended.

email.description: Mandatory unique email of the user (highly secured PII).

subjects.description: Academic subjects list available in Kinetic Academy.

lessons.description: Lecture notes and chapters linked to specific subjects.

tasks.description: Standard daily tasks tracked per-user to keep progress and streak on track.

quizzes.description: Entire structured question bank synced per subject.

students.description: Highly guarded student registration profiles containing details, ranking score metrics and experience.
